title: Flow with callouts
summary: Columns along a path, left to right, each carrying the callouts that sit on it: what leaks or breaks there, drawn solid when this design fixes it and dashed when it is left for a later design. Each callout names the decision or open item that fixes it in `by`, shown as that entry's handle under the title, and the renderer writes the legend itself. The renderer measures every label and spaces the columns to their callouts, so nothing overlaps.
belongs: A compare panel whose figure lays findings along a request path; a callout's topic names the .xs-topic row it explains, and the two highlight each other.

col.description: the id of the column this callout sits on

title.description: what leaks or breaks at this stage, in plain words

status.description: fixed when this design closes it, later when it stays for a follow-up

by.description: the decision or open item that fixes it, by id, shown as its handle; a short phrase when no entry fits

side.description: which side of the column; unset callouts go above, the fourth and later below

topic.description: the .xs-topic text of the compare row this callout explains

arrows.description: arrows between consecutive columns; on unless set to false
